evals.prompt: Use the to-issues workflow on this implementation brief. You are in an empty sandbox with no initialized .ait project; do not initialize ait. Draft the implementation issue set you would create, include the issue body fields, and ask how I want to proceed with ait setup instead of claiming issues were created. Brief: Add saved search alerts to an existing issue tracker. Users can save a query, choose daily or immediate email alerts, receive notifications when new matching issues appear, and disable alerts from settings. Constraints: reuse the existing issue search UI and email job framework; include a design-review checkpoint only if needed before implementation.
